summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — CHTR +4%, STE +4%, GPN +4%, FIS +4%, FOXA +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (AMD -9%, DELL -7%, CSCO -6%, COHR -6%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: AMD (-8.75%) — no obvious news catalyst found for 2026-11-16; searches returned nothing dated that day. An -8.75% drop looks like a sector-wide AI/semiconductor sell-off or a valuation de-rating. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: AMD is a mega-cap semiconductor name that no strategy lists. With no catalyst, the move looks like a gradual sector sell-off, which a long-only momentum or mean-reversion bot has no way to trade.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found for 11/16. Likely a rebound in a heavily sold-off name (52-wk range ~$112–$309) after the Cox deal closed and the stock fell on debt concerns, or a cable/telecom sector move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: CHTR is a large-cap cable/telecom name that no strategy includes. A +4% rebound with no catalyst also wouldn't trigger a news-reactive signal, and a name in a long downtrend would likely fail momentum trend filters.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change. Adding a mean-reversion strategy universe slot for large-cap telecom/media with RSI<35 and a >3% up-day trigger could catch similar rebounds, but a single unexplained move doesn't justify it.

top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. GPN is a mid/large-cap payments processor that no strategy lists. With no discrete same-day news event, a news-reactive trigger would not have fired, and a gap or momentum screen likely never evaluated it.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a dynamic universe expander that admits any US name with market cap above $10B and a 5-day return of at least +8% or volume of at least 1.5x its 20-day average, so momentum-trader can evaluate non-listed stocks like GPN.
